name: Original Group Header 23
definition: Provides the details on the original group, to which the message refers.

OriginalGroupCancellationIdentification.name: Original Group Cancellation Identification
OriginalGroupCancellationIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the original assigner, to unambiguously identify the original group cancellation request.

OriginalMessageIdentification.name: Original Message Identification
OriginalMessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference, as assigned by the original instructing party, to unambiguously identify the original message.

OriginalMessageNameIdentification.name: Original Message Name Identification
OriginalMessageNameIdentification.definition: Specifies the original message name identifier to which the message refers.

OriginalCreationDateTime.name: Original Creation Date Time
OriginalCreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the original message was created.

OriginalNumberOfTransactions.name: Original Number Of Transactions
OriginalNumberOfTransactions.definition: Number of individual transactions contained in the original message.

OriginalControlSum.name: Original Control Sum
OriginalControlSum.definition: Total of all individual amounts included in the original message, irrespective of currencies.

GroupCancellationStatus.name: Group Cancellation Status
GroupCancellationStatus.definition: Specifies the status of a group cancellation request.

CancellationStatusReasonInformation.name: Cancellation Status Reason Information
CancellationStatusReasonInformation.definition: Provides detailed information on the cancellation status reason.

NumberOfTransactionsPerCancellationStatu.name: Number Of Transactions Per Cancellation Status
NumberOfTransactionsPerCancellationStatu.definition: Detailed information on the number of transactions for each identical cancellation status.

CancellationStatusReasonInformationRule.definition: If GroupCancellationStatus is present and is different from RejectedCancellationRequest (RJCR) or PendingCancellationRequest (PDCR), then CancellationStatusReasonInformation/AdditionalInformation is not allowed.

NumberOfTransactionsPerCancellationStatu.definition: OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/NumberOfTransactionsPerStatus should only be present if GroupCancellationStatus equals PACR.
